'''FC Stade Lausanne Ouchy''', sometimes referred to as '''SLO''', is a Swiss professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Ouchy]], [[Lausanne]]. They have played in the [[Swiss Challenge League]] since 2024, following relegation from the [[Swiss Super League]]."}}
